clue.text: When abroad, stars create difficult situations

parts.note: quand is the French word for when, so abroad points to the foreign form
Aries is a constellation and zodiac sign, a group of stars

explanation.surface: Travelling overseas, celebrities make awkward scenes for everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stars' looks like celebrities but is the constellation ARIES; 'abroad' asks for the French word for 'when'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dilemmas and predicaments are tricky situations with no easy way out.

clue.text: Stir created by publicity bod in Arab republic

indicators.note: the publicity person sits inside the abbreviation for the Arab republic

parts.note: UAR is the United Arab Republic, the union of Egypt and Syria
a PRO is a public relations officer, someone who handles publicity

explanation.surface: A press officer causes a fuss while posted in an Arab state.
explanation.definitionFit: A stir is a commotion or tumult, a noisy public disturbance.

clue.text: From what's said, is aware of prohibited equipment at Aintree

indicators.note: the phrase signals that the words are spoken, so we write down how they sound

parts.note: is aware of means knows, and prohibited means banned, said together

explanation.surface: Apparently someone knows which kit is outlawed at the Grand National course.
explanation.walkthrough: AINTREE is the Liverpool racecourse that hosts the Grand National, a famous horse race, so the equipment is horse tack.
explanation.definitionFit: A noseband is a strap of a horse's bridle, part of the tack used in racing.

clue.text: Moulding and paintings turning up in singular collection of old stuff

indicators.note: the turned paintings go inside the word for a collection of old records

parts.note: an archive is a single store of old records; singular steers away from the plural form

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the word for paintings is read from bottom to top

parts.note: art is a general word for paintings

explanation.surface: Decorative trim and pictures surface in an old storehouse of documents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' works because this is a down clue: the paintings word is read bottom to top. 'singular' steers to the one-store form rather than the plural.
explanation.definitionFit: An architrave is the moulded frame around a door or window.

clue.text: Number, say, inhabiting Bury

indicators.note: the word for say lives inside the word for bury

parts.note: to inter is to bury a body
e.g. means for example, as say does

explanation.surface: A count, for instance, living in the Lancashire town of Bury.
explanation.walkthrough: Bury is a town near Manchester, but here it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A whole number such as seven is an example of a numeral.

clue.text: Fish sinks, tail half disappearing

indicators.note: the back half of the word for sinks is lost, leaving its first four letters

parts.note: to scupper a ship is to sink it deliberately

explanation.surface: A fish goes under, the back half of its body vanishing.
explanation.walkthrough: SCUPPERS loses its last four letters, PERS.
explanation.definitionFit: The scup is a porgy, an edible sea species of the American Atlantic coast.

clue.text: Blasted out inner elementary particle

indicators.note: something blasted is blown apart, so these letters are scattered and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A tiny particle was blown out of the inner part of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blasted' rearranges OUTINNER.
explanation.definitionFit: The neutrino is a subatomic particle with almost no mass and no charge.

clue.text: After game leader advanced position

indicators.note: the word for leader comes after the word for the game

parts.note: bridge is a card game
a head is a leader, as of a school

explanation.surface: Once the match was over, the captain took up a forward post.
explanation.definitionFit: A bridgehead is a forward foothold gained in enemy territory by an attacking force.

clue.text: One wont succeed on one's own

definitions.text: One wont succeed on one's own

parts.words: One wont succeed on one's own
parts.note: describes a person who will inherit, but only as one of several sharing the estate

explanation.surface: Someone who cannot make it without help.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a pep talk about teamwork; 'succeed' really means inherit, as an heir succeeds to an estate. The paper prints won't.
explanation.definitionFit: A joint heir shares an inheritance with others rather than receiving it alone.

clue.text: A path that goes at an angle through the wood?

definitions.text: A path that goes at an angle through the wood?

parts.words: A path that goes at an angle through the wood?
parts.note: reads as a forest trail, but describes a saw's cut across the grain of timber

explanation.surface: A diagonal trail through the forest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wood' suggests trees; it is timber being sawn across the grain.
explanation.definitionFit: A crosscut is a cut made across the grain of timber, as a crosscut saw makes.

clue.text: Made amends for former relationship with a young thug

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-husband
pi is a ratio, the fixed relationship between a circle's circumference and diameter
a Ted, short for Teddy boy, was a 1950s youth gang member

explanation.surface: Someone atoned for a past romance with a teenage hooligan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'former relationship' looks like one unit, an ex-partner, but 'relationship' is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. A Teddy boy was a 1950s British youth in Edwardian dress, often seen as a tearaway.
explanation.definitionFit: To atone for a wrong is to make up for it or pay its penalty.

clue.text: Boat for a Malay

parts.note: pro means in favour of, i.e. for

explanation.surface: A vessel used by someone from Malaysia.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines a Malay sailing craft while 'for a' gives PRO and A.
explanation.definitionFit: The proa is a fast outrigger sailing vessel of the Malay archipelago.

clue.text: How'S Europe to be turned into an energetic driving force?

indicators.note: the letters are to be changed into something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A question of how a continent might become a dynamo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be turned into' rearranges HOWSEUROPE.
explanation.definitionFit: A dynamic, forceful person or organisation is called a dynamo or powerhouse figure in everyday idiom.

clue.text: The orchestra's leader toiled playing instrument

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter
playing suggests the letters are played about with and rearranged

explanation.surface: The orchestra's principal violinist laboured at playing an instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' rearranges TOILED to DOLITE.
explanation.definitionFit: A theodolite is a surveyor's device for measuring angles.

clue.text: Group presenting idea, not put any old how?

indicators.note: means carelessly or in random order, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A delegation brings a proposal but sets it down carelessly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'any old how' rearranges IDEANOTPUT.
explanation.definitionFit: A deputation is a delegation sent to put a case to someone.

clue.text: Aggressive person's act?

parts.note: an aggressive, fiery person is a spitfire, and their act could be a sudden unofficial strike

explanation.surface: The behaviour of someone hostile.
explanation.walkthrough: A fierce person is a wildcat, and a wildcat action is an unofficial strike.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot-tempered person is called a wildcat, and a wildcat strike is sudden unofficial action.

clue.text: Very much like material offered by poet

parts.note: to love something is to like it very much
lace is a delicate fabric

explanation.surface: A versifier offers a fabric that pleases greatly.
explanation.walkthrough: Richard Lovelace was a 17th-century English Cavalier poet.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard Lovelace was a Cavalier writer of verse, known for To Althea.

clue.text: Is poem on record just one of a series listened to?

definitions.text: just one of a series listened to

indicators.note: on in an across clue means the following pieces come after the record

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: Asking whether a recorded poem is a single instalment of a radio serial.
explanation.definitionFit: An instalment of a broadcast drama is one part of a serial.

clue.text: The sun overarches one northern city and a midland town

indicators.note: in a down clue the sun word sits over the rest

parts.note: Sol is the Latin name for the sun
I is the Roman numeral for one
Hull is a city in the north of England

explanation.surface: Sunlight spans one city in the north and a town in the Midlands.
explanation.walkthrough: Solihull is a town near Birmingham in the English Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: Solihull is a market town in the West Midlands of England.

clue.text: Novice taken in by crossword compiler may be a colonist

indicators.note: the novice is held inside the word for a compiler

parts.note: a setter compiles crosswords
L is a learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: A beginner fooled by a puzzle writer might be a pioneer.
explanation.definitionFit: A settler is a pioneer who makes a home in a new land.

clue.text: Right wicked people may get it, not half

annotationWithheld.why: Right wicked people may get it, not half (10): R + EVIL + MEN + T (half of 'it') gives REVILMENT, an E short of REVILEMENT; no reading found that supplies the E, and the clue matches the scan
annotationWithheld.clue: Right wicked people may get it, not half

clue.text: Live briefly, turning blue

indicators.note: turning means the shortened word is read backwards
briefly means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: to dwell somewhere is to live there

explanation.surface: Life cut short makes someone sad.
explanation.walkthrough: DWELL cut short ('briefly') is DWEL, which 'turning' reverses. 'blue' means risqué, not sad.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue jokes are smutty or indecent, i.e. obscene.

clue.text: Solution to a coot's problem — time with another bird!

parts.note: bald as a coot is an idiom, so a hairpiece solves the baldness
an eon is a vast period of time

explanation.surface: A coot's problem solved, with some time and a second bird!
explanation.walkthrough: 'bald as a coot' is a British idiom; a hairpiece cures baldness. The coot misleads towards water birds.
explanation.definitionFit: The wigeon is a dabbling duck, so a waterfowl other than the coot.

clue.text: 'Eggs-diary' — it's possibly made by me?

parts.note: O looks like an egg, so two eggs give OO, and a log is a diary

indicators.note: possibly means the letters of it's could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A record of eggs, perhaps kept by the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'me' is the speaker, an egg collector who keeps such a record; 'possibly' rearranges ITS to IST.
explanation.definitionFit: The speaker is an egg collector, the scientist who studies birds' eggs.

clue.text: The smallest amount I won't eat — not even bits

indicators.note: take only the odd letters of the phrase, skipping the even ones

explanation.surface: Someone refusing to eat even the tiniest morsel.
explanation.walkthrough: The odd letters of I WONT EAT give the pick.
explanation.definitionFit: Not an iota means not the slightest bit; it is a tiny quantity.

clue.text: Guided around, I certainly may be taking things easily

indicators.note: the word for guided goes around the other pieces

parts.note: led means guided
sure is an informal certainly

explanation.surface: Escorted on a tour, I am happily relaxing.
explanation.definitionFit: Leisured describes having plenty of free time, unhurried and relaxed.

clue.text: Mystery about to be revealed in religious faction

indicators.note: the word for about appears inside the word for a faction

parts.note: a sect is a religious group
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A mystery is about to be exposed within a cult.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to be revealed' reads as one phrase but splits: RE, then 'to be revealed in' places it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hidden or unknown is an enigma kept from others.

clue.text: Hormone provided by a doctor to woman with stroke

parts.note: Ena is a woman's name
a line is a stroke of a pen

explanation.surface: A hormone given by a doctor to a woman who has had a stroke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stroke' suggests illness; it is a pen line.
explanation.definitionFit: Epinephrine, the fight-or-flight chemical, is secreted by the adrenal glands.
